description: This file defines a utility enum SimpleTaskSupport providing static methods to manage asynchronous tasks, including starting, stopping, and running a detached loop with interval delays.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts an asynchronous task if none is running, executing the provided operation.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Cancels the ongoing task if it exists, and sets it to nil.

methods.name: startDetachedLoop
methods.description: Starts a detached task executing the operation repeatedly at specified intervals until cancelled.
